dnterviews with their families, friends and 

work cokkeagues to establish a pook of opinion.

ADMISSTON 


Admission to the association is open to those 

who have already taken the advanced section 

of the FUNCTIONAL BILINGUALISM Faench or English 
Language courses, or who have an equivalent 
proficiency. ALL negistering students must 

first take a diagnostic test, 40 that their Level 
of abikity in the second Language may be accurately 
measured. The association can onky admit those 
people who possess a good knowledge of both 

French and English. 


The programme is every Tuesday evening from 


6:00 to 9:00 p.m,
